item.title: Demystifying ITR-2: My FY 2025-26 Tax Filing Journey
item.description: A schedule-by-schedule reconstruction of my actual ITR-2 filing for FY 2025-26 — backtracking every schedule from Salary (Sched S) to Other Sources (Sched OS), Capital Gains (Sched CG & 112A), Foreign Assets (Sched FA), Assets & Liabilities (Sched AL), and TCS tax credit setoff.
